column1: # sdk/descriptors.tsv — every method/type descriptor the runtime spells
# from Rust that names a class: `ident<TAB>descriptor`, original spelling.
# build_support/names.rs turns each row into a `d::<ident>` const whose
# value has every L<class>; reference rewritten through the active shrink
# map (identity without --shrink). Hand-maintained: add a row when a new
# descriptor is needed; idents are `<param>_<param>__<return>` with simple
